import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(s):
    # Transliterate non-ASCII characters to their closest ASCII equivalents.
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    s = s.encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii')
    s = s.lower()
    # Keep alphanumerics; turn every other character into a dash.
    out = [ch if ch.isalnum() else '-' for ch in s]
    s = ''.join(out)
    # Collapse runs of dashes and trim the edges.
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s)
    return s.strip('-')

import unicodedata
import re


def slugify(s):
    s = s.lower()
    # Transliterate unicode characters (e.g. õ -> o)
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(ch for ch in s if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    # Replace all runs of non-alphanumeric chars with a single dash
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    # Strip leading/trailing dashes
    return s.strip('-')

    used = set()
    counts = {}
